acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct, circular reddish-pink lesion or abrasion is visible on the upper dorsal surface, posterior to the head and near the area of high-intensity surface light reflection.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal fish (remoras) located beneath the ventral surface and two yellow-and-black striped fish in the foreground; dynamic caustic networks from surface light refraction are projected across the anterior dorsal skin.
